description: Enforces secure TLS transport for modern browsers.
recommendation: Set Strict-Transport-Security to at least 1 year with includeSubDomains.

description: Restricts authorized sources of scripts and resources.
recommendation: Define a strict CSP policy that eliminates inline script execution.
Configure X-Frame-Options to DENY or SAMEORIGIN.

description: Disables MIME type sniffing for static assets.
recommendation: Set X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff on all HTTP responses.

description: Controls how much referrer information is sent along with requests.
recommendation: Set Referrer-Policy to strict-origin-when-cross-origin or no-referrer.

description: Restricts browser features and hardware APIs.
recommendation: Specify Permissions-Policy to lock down unused browser device APIs.

description: Protects against cross-origin attacks by isolating browsing context.
Prevents a document from loading any cross-origin resources that don't explicitly grant permission.
recommendation: Enable COEP where resource isolation is required.

description: Exposes server name and version string.
recommendation: Strip or obfuscate the Server response header in proxy or web server config.

description: Exposes application runtime and framework stack.
recommendation: Disable X-Powered-By in web framework configuration.
